name: folkore-mcp-server
description: Folklore — memory companion MCP App for aging parents with dementia

scripts.dev: cross-env NODE_ENV=development concurrently "cross-env INPUT=mcp-app.html vite build --watch" "tsx --watch main.ts"
scripts.build: cross-env INPUT=mcp-app.html vite build && tsc -p tsconfig.server.json
scripts.start: cross-env NODE_ENV=development npm run build && npm run serve
